error[ZBX-E1011]: the virtual machine could not be set up for this user
  cause  the guest could not set up its cgroup
  fix    stop the machine; the next command starts a fresh one:   zbx vm stop
         read how far the guest got:                              tail -n 20 '/Users/ada/Library/Application Support/zbx/vm/console.log'
  more   zbx explain E1011 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1011.html
